notes.title: Highway Blossoms 1.2.5 — Maintenance Update
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

Highway Blossoms 1.2.5 has just been released, which fixes a few minor issues.

As always, thank you for continuing to support Studio Élan!

〜 Karen/あけみ (akemin_dayo) and adirosa

[h2]Changelog for 1.2.5:[/h2]
On PC, it targets Ren'Py SDK versions 8.1.3.23091805 〜 7.5.3.22090809.

[list]
[*] Certain trophies will no longer unlock simply by opening the preference pane. You have to unlock them the intended way now.
[*] Made a certain Goofball Mode feature easier to find in the UI.
[*] Merged changes and improvements made in common code shared with other Studio Élan games.
	[list]
	[*] Improved graphical sharpness and presentation on the Steam Deck when launched via SteamOS Gaming Mode (`gamescope`). (※ Specifically, the game will now always launch in fullscreen mode if launched from SteamOS `gamescope`. Running the game from the KDE desktop environment is unaffected by this change.)
	[*] You can now scroll CGs with the keyboard in the CG viewer by holding down the arrow keys instead of having to rapidly tap them.
	[/list]
[*] Made various other internal refactors and improvements.
[/list]

※ Newer copies of the Gold Rush Edition physical PC release will be using 1.2.5 going forward, instead of the previous 1.2.

notes.title: Highway Blossoms 1.2.3 — Maintenance Update
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

Highway Blossoms 1.2.3 has just been released, which fixes a few issues of varying severity!

Of particular note, this release fixes the "FTFont NoneType" crash that was affecting certain users — thank you to everyone that reported and helped test this elusive issue, as we were completely unable to reproduce this on our local testing environments without your help! And our apologies for all the inconvenience that was experienced.

Additionally, using the Steam "Betas" feature to downgrade to 1.1.1, 1.1, and 1.0 should now work correctly, fixing the "unsupported pickle protocol: 5" error. (※ You may need to restart your Steam client for the changes to take effect, as the changes were made to Steamworks metadata and not to any actual game code or data.)

Thank you all for remaining patient, and as always, thank you for continuing to support Studio Élan!

〜 Karen/あけみ (akemin_dayo) and adirosa
[h2]Changelog for 1.2.3:[/h2]
On PC, it targets Ren'Py SDK versions 8.1.3.23091805 〜 7.5.3.22090809.
[list][*]Fixed the infamous "FTFont NoneType" crash that would occur only for certain users when attempting to draw a text box.[list][*]Running Highway Blossoms 1.2.3 at least once will apply modifications to your persistent save data in such a way that downgrading back to any version that was previously affected by the crash (1.2.2 〜 1.2) will now work on system configurations that were previously crashing.[list][*][b]※ Note for people running downgraded versions:[/b] Fully deleting your persistent save data while on an affected version above will cause the crash to come back until 1.2.3 or newer is run at least once again to fix up your persistent save data.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed a crash that would occur if the user navigated to Marina's Thoughts, then to either the CG Gallery or the Guest Art sections in that specific order.[/*][*]Fixed the wrong item name being used for the "Miner's Journal" (as "Hiker's Journal") in Marina's Thoughts.[/*][*]Fixed a typo in the "Cassette" item (as "Casette") in Marina's Thoughts.[/*][*]Made various other internal refactors and improvements.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Highway Blossoms 1.2.2, 1.2.1, and 1.2
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

We've just released a major update to Highway Blossoms!

… In fact, we released [i]three[/i] versions in rapid succession just now — 1.2.2, 1.2.1, and 1.2! (※ More on this below.)

Our apologies for the large delay in getting these versions out — various external factors beyond our control prevented us from properly releasing these updates, despite them being feature-complete for the longest time.

This release fixes many long-standing issues of varying severity including achievements / trophies, vastly improves controller navigation support, and adds native Apple Silicon (arm64 / AArch64) support for macOS, as well as ARM Linux (arm64 / AArch64, armv7) — notably including Asahi Linux (arm64e / Apple Silicon)!

All that being said, we thank you all for remaining patient, and as always, for supporting Studio Élan across these many years!

※ If for some reason you want to downgrade the game to an earlier version, you can now do this using Steam's "Betas" tab, accessible via right-clicking on the game in Steam and selecting "Properties". Please note that save data from newer versions, including your persistent save data, may cause crashing or other erratic behaviour when downgrading versions.

notes.title: Highway Blossoms: Next Exit & Artbook Release, Base Game Update
notes.content:
Heyo everyone,

Lots of big news today. The main ones, of course, are the releases of Highway Blossoms: Next Exit and the artbook! I've talked about those a bunch before, so I won't repeat myself too much here. Go pick them up!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/490270/Highway_Blossoms_Next_Exit/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1412300/Highway_Blossoms__Official_Artbook/

To access Highway Blossoms: Next Exit, go to the "Extras" tab from the main menu (which may require beating the game once to unlock) and then go to "DLC Content." You'll be able to start the DLC story from there!

Alongside that, we've got a big update for the base Highway Blossoms game again, arguably even bigger than the Remastered update a couple years ago. Buckle in, because it's about to get bumpy.

Longtime HB fans might not be surprised to see this, but unfortunately, this update is likely going to break your saves. It's an unfortunate result of the engine that we use for Highway Blossoms (more specifically some custom modifications to it) and there's not really a way to avoid it. We're sorry for the inconvenience 😔 You can hold down ctrl to quickly skip through text to get back to where you were before.

Broken saves is the only bad news, though. Now onto the good!

The first change you'll probably notice is the new GUI in the game. We've totally renovated all of the menus and interface, and added some extra features. For one, there are new accessibility options, and a light/dark mode for the game. Now you can play Good Highway Blossoms and Evil Highway Blossoms. There's also a new music player and improved art gallery (make sure to check out the Next Exit guest art too!).

In the gallery, you might notice a new section called "Marina's Thoughts." We've added a number of cut-in illustrations throughout the game for certain items that come up in the story - stuff like the journal, the gold, meals the girls eat, and more. In addition to seeing them in-game, you can check them out in the gallery as well, for a quick opinion from Marina on each item.

There are a couple other new sections that you can find under "Extras" in the Legacy Content area. For one thing, you can now find all things Goofball mode here: EZ Mode, Extreme Mode, and the new form of Goofball mode itself: rather than requiring a whole other playthrough with a couple changed lines, Goofball mode is now in more of a highlight reel format that simply features The Jokes. We did remove a couple jokes that we felt weren't in good taste, though.

On that note, the Jumbo Scene from the original game has also been moved to the Legacy Content area. This means that the scene is no longer part of a playthrough of the regular game. However, you can reread that scene in its entirety from the menu.

Finally, we made the slightest of changes to music in the game, by adding one new track. It's a song that was written for Next Exit, but we chose to add it into the base game too. If you own the soundtrack DLC here on Steam, you'll automatically get the new tracks from Next Exit - even if you don't own Next Exit itself. Instead you can listen to the songs and imagine how they might be used, I suppose.

A Chinese translation for Next Exit is in the works, and will be added as soon as it's completed. Also, 'cause I've seen a few people asking: there's no new adult content or new Goofball Mode content in Next Exit.

Whether you play NE or not, we hope you enjoy these newest improvements to Highway Blossoms. Can't wait to be on my deathbed in a few decades and still rolling out updates to the game then.

notes.title: Highway Blossoms: Next Exit + Artbook Coming September 25th
notes.content:
Hey gamers,

As the event title, subtitle, and summary all probably told you: both Highway Blossoms: Next Exit and the Official Artbook will be releasing as DLC on September 25th.

If you don't know what those are then cool, because I'll explain. If you do then skip to the bottom of this or something.

Next Exit is a brand new story DLC set just a little while after the base game. Amber and Marina return to Las Vegas and to meet up with Tess for her birthday. Coincidentally, Tess' birthday is September 25. See what we did there? As you might expect, not everything goes as planned. There's laughter, there's tears, there's Cassi the candy shop girl. All that good stuff you want from a Highway Blossoms game. Or at least, so we hope.

It's a little over half the length of the original game. It's got brand new CG's and backgrounds, and even some new/improved sprites. It's got a brand new GUI that will also be replacing the GUI in the main game.  It's got new item cut-ins, including some for the base game too. It's fully voice acted by the original cast. It's got new music* from all the original composers. It's pretty cool.

Highway Blossoms: Next Exit will cost $9.99 and will require the base game to play. Add it to your wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/490270/Highway_Blossoms_Next_Exit

You can check out the official trailer right here:

[previewyoutube=Sc5E1NHs0wY;full][/previewyoutube]

It's in .pdf format and includes all the art from the game, concept art, merch designs and bonus illustrations, plus commentary from a bunch of us developers. It's like reading a whole book of patch notes! But more exciting and with more pretty pictures. One thing: the artbook does NOT contain the images from the 18+ DLC.

notes.title: Change In Developer For HB
notes.content:
Attention: This establishment is now under new management. Sort of.

Starting today (technically a couple days ago), Highway Blossoms is no longer going to be under the Alienworks name. From here on out, it'll be jointly listed under Studio Coattails and Studio Élan, the two groups that Syon and I formed back in 2017. So what does this mean for HB? In the short-term, not a whole lot. The recent update to the game just changes the logos and credits (and also changes one joke from goofball mode so that we won't get sued). Long term, it means that you can look forward to HB merchandise from both studios, as well as extra content on the [url=https://www.patreon.com/vnstudioelan]Studio Élan Patreon[/url]. Anything in the future that we do that uses the Highway Blossoms IP will be under the same two names, as well.

While this is a great time to replay HB (since, let's face it, any time is a great time to replay HB), if you're looking for something new, both Studio Coattails and Studio Élan have some recent releases. At Studio Élan, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/844660/Heart_of_the_Woods/]we just released Heart of the Woods[/url] about a month ago. It's another yuri game, this time in the fantasy genre. It's about a duo who run a paranormal investigation blog, and travel to a remote mountain village to investigate rumors of... Well, the paranormal. Spoilers: they find it.

Not into yuri? First of all, why are you on this page? But aside from that, on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1036580/National_Park_Girls/]March 14, Studio Coattails is releasing Episode 1 of National Park Girls[/url]. Just like the title implies, it's a story about US national parks. As anime girls. Just like HB, it's got full English voice acting, including some familiar faces. Well, voices. While it's fully a Studio Coattails project, it's one that Syon and I are writing together. Episode 1 is all Syon, while I'll be writing episodes 2 and 3, and then Syon's writing 4 and 5. As mentioned, this one isn't a romance title, although there are still some... Shall we say, romantic undertones? But they're not at the forefront of the story.

Anyway, that's it for now. It's so heartwarming to see people discovering and enjoying HB still, even a couple years after release. We hope that you'll stick with us for our new projects and enjoy those too. Until next time!

Cheers,
Josh

notes.title: Announcing Some New Games From Some Of Us
notes.content:
I tried like four different titles for this post and none of them sounded good, so you're stuck with that one. I'm not happy about it either.

Before getting to the new announcement stuff, a quick update on HB: Remastered, to technically make this post relevant: voice acting is progressing pretty nicely, and will hopefully continue to do so. We've got one of the fixed up CG's from Weee, and she's currently working on a new CG that wasn't present in the original game. Smoke Thief (formerly Anna Logue) has touched up the mastering on his music, so it sounds way better - both the in-game versions and the ones from the soundtrack DLC. We're still hoping to have HB:R out by December, just in time [strike]for everyone to buy it for your friends for the holidays[/strike] to make it a nice holiday present to you all =3 We'll keep you posted on how it goes.

Also, because a few people asked on the last update: Syon's still plugging away at "Dusty Trails," the HB spin-off light novel that he's been working on for the past [indeterminate amount of time]. He's gotten a pretty good chunk of the first volume written, and while it's too early for a release date, it's coming along nicely.

Now for the good stuff. While we collectively as Alienworks are still hard at work on HRP, Syon - the director and other writer for HB - and myself have both started our own new VN studios on the side, for making other games.

Syon just started Coattails Studio, a group for exploring all kinds of weird and unique stories - and not just visual novels. Right now, they're working on a game called "Same As It Ever Was," which is a Lovecraftian, surreal game. The character designs and art are being done by Shiyun, who was also the lead artist here on HB, so you know it's gonna look good. Give 'em a follow over on [url=https://twitter.com/coattailsstudio]ze Twitters[/url] if you'd like. 

Additionally, I started Studio Élan, which is a really pain to type, lemme tell ya, because of that É. With Studio Élan, I want to make more yuri games in a similar vein as HB: tasteful and cute, rather than super lewd. Just last weekend, we announced our first two games: "Heart of the Woods," which is a mystical story involving a ghost girl in a magic forest, and "The Waters Above," which is about a sea nymph who's in charge of taking care of the stars. The artist for HotW is Rosuuri, who did some CG's for HB like [spoiler]the kiss scenes and Marina in Vegas[/spoiler], and the artist for TWA is Namie, who hasn't worked on a visual novel before. You can [url=https://twitter.com/vnstudioelan]stalk us in the Twitterverse as well.[/url]

There are also Discord servers for both groups, which you can find on our respective Twitter pages.

Anyway, that's about it for this time. Pls look forward to our upcoming games. The new HRP demo will hopefully be out by the end of this year, but considering our previous luck with announcing release windows and then flying right past 'em, we're not gonna commit to that.

Thanks for reading this stuff. It really does mean a lot to me/us.

Cheers!

notes.title: Discord & Russian Translation + Important Fix for Mac Sierra Users
notes.content:
Remember when I said the last update would probably be the final?

Yeah, me either.

Thanks to the efforts of the translation team Mehlate, a free Russian language option has been added for Highway Blossoms. To use it, please activate the beta branch of the game by navigating to Highway Blossoms in your Steam library, right-clicking the title,  clicking "Properties" and choose the "betabuild" option from the Beta tab. Then, load the game and go into "Preferences" and choose "Russian" as your language. This translation was created by Mehlate and we're very grateful for their efforts. However, please be aware that neither Alienworks nor Sekai Project can guarantee its quality or accuracy.

For users with the Mac Sierra OS, it's important to activate the beta branch. Sierra brought with it a change that makes all games created on Ren'Py unplayable without a particular change. Please download the new build from the beta branch to fix that. Because it requires fundamentally altering the game engine, we can't promise save integrity. Hey, at least this time it won't be on us.

Last but not least is something that I've forgotten to bring up for the past several updates: Alienworks has a [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/0wNSKKFUJf0N2ICh]public Discord server[/url] that everyone is welcome to join if you wanna chat with us, or other fans, or just lurk.

As always, thanks for your support, and we hope you continue to enjoy Highway Blossoms.

notes.title: Info On Our Next Game
notes.content:
Hey guys,

Long time no talk. First off, I just wanted to say thanks again to everyone who has played HB. We're super stoked that most people seem to like it. Coming across people who have changed their profile pics on Steam and social media to use HB characters is seriously heartwarming. And we read every single review that's left for the game, so thanks to those who have left 'em.

Anyway, we just pushed what's probably going to be the last update to HB for a while, setting the changes from the 1.32 beta to live. If you opted into the beta previously, you shouldn't notice anything different.

If you enjoyed Highway Blossoms enough to want to follow the rest of what we're working on, then I've got good news: Just today, we posted a new trailer from our upcoming, 6 route visual novel "The Human Reignition Project." It's a BxG, romance/thriller game, due out sometime next year. The new trailer also premieres our brand new opening theme, REIGNITE, with vocals by Sasaki Sayaka (Girls Und Panzer, Nichijou, Planetarian) and composed by ARTE REFACT (Love Live, Idolm@ster, and more). You can check that out at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TD4GtZLkUcQ

We held a Kickstarter campaign for HRP last year which is what enabled us to put so much into the game. However, we wanted to give our newer fans a chance to grab some of the stuff we offered during that. So, we've opened pre-orders on a few select items like body pillows and physical copies of the game. You can pick those up at https://the-human-reignition-project-an-english-visual-nov.backerkit.com/hosted_preorders

For the most concise description of HRP and to see where the money's going, please check out the Kickstarter page. https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sekaiproject/the-human-reignition-project-an-english-visual-nov/description You'll see, however, that we've upgraded the sprites from what's shown on there - the versions in the trailer are the most recent ones.

As always, thanks for checking our stuff out. If you want more frequent, smaller updates (as well as the occasional extra bit of HB and HRP art) be sure to follow us on Twitter @AlienworksDev

notes.title: Optional Update - Version 1.32
notes.content:
We've pushed an optional update for Highway Blossoms to the beta branch of the game. As with the other updates we've pushed, it'll most likely corrupt saves, which is why we're not setting it to the main branch of the game yet. 

Here's what it does:

• Implemented small and medium sized screen device UI. Doesn’t affect Steam users except for some extreme cases where the OS might expose itself as a tablet or phone interface. If you're playing on a calculator, this is the update for you.

• Fixed some sprite positioning errors caused by the previous patch’s ghosting fixes. It's a trickle-down bugfix process.

• Fixed a ton of spelling and continuity errors thanks to the efforts of the Steam community. Marina no longer randomly gains and loses a sibling.

• Added small notification in main menu to let you know if the adult content has been installed properly. ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)


•Implemented a slower but more robust saving system and a slightly reduced rollback limit to hopefully help with the constant save breaking.

•Can now hide the Gallery navigation menu with the H key. Fitting button, right?

•EZ Mode only plays "The Bear Prayer" in a single channel, rather than twice at once. We have been informed that that that's not how stereo audio works.

•In Skip mode, switching between "Read" and "All" is now a toggle. Trying to word that sentence was roughly as confusing as explaining how it worked before.

As stated, right now this is available as a beta update, which means that you have to opt-in to download it. To do that, find Highway Blossoms in your Steam library, right-click (or equivalent) on the title, and go to "Properties." Then, under the "betas" tab, choose "betafixes" from the drop-down menu at the top. You should immediately begin to download the patch. There is no password required.

Like always, thank you very much for playing Highway Blossoms! ^.^

notes.title: Version Update - 1.22
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We have a smallish patch that fixes a few things; see below for the full list. Unfortunately, this one will definitely corrupt save files, as we changed the save directory, so you’ll need to restart the game. However, you can quickly get back to where you were by opening the in-game menu, changing the “Skip text” option to “Skip All Messages” (not just “read messages,” as the patch will reset what it thinks you’ve read before), and holding control. You can also press tab to toggle skip mode on/off. We apologize for the inconvenience.

Highway Blossoms: The Definitive Version Until We Realize Something Else is Wrong

-Corrects multiple typos and grammatical errors. We r good @ writng
-Fixed an issue with some of the journal entries not triggering correctly. Amber is no longer clairvoyant and doesn’t randomly know where to go next.
-Adjusts visual direction and smooths out sprite animation. Our programmer says we enabled subpixel, whatever that means ¯\_(ツ)_/¯
-Opening credits adjusted for consistency, and to actually properly credit everyone (Sorry Rosu!)
-Adds CG gallery accessible from extras menu. Yes, it includes all installed CG’s ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)
-Fixes issue of ghost sprites when skipping text. This is not a horror game.
-Ambient sounds now cut out when they should. Leaving the engine running all through the Grand Canyon is bad for the environment.
-Repaired Amber’s hand in one of the driving CG’s. She’s now shadier.
-Broke your saves again
